Role: Service Delivery Manager

Department: Managed Services

Visa Sponsorship: You must have legal working rights in the country of your residence within the European region. Sponsorship is only available within the Netherlands.

What is your goal? As a Service Delivery Manager, you are accountable for delivering high-quality managed services to international customers. You oversee complex service environments across Dynamics 365, Azure, integrations, and data, ensuring operational stability, customer satisfaction and continuous improvement.

**Leading Microsoft Partner

**HSO belongs to the elite Microsoft Dynamics Inner Circle for 21 years, within the top 1% of all Microsoft partners worldwide. With over 2,800 professionals, and a worldwide presence, we deliver successful implementations across industries globally.

**HSO International

**At HSO International, you’ll join a diverse team of 300+ colleagues from 50+ nationalities, working on cross-border projects that make a global impact.

Learn more about Life at HSO International: https://www.hso.com/en/campaigns/life-at-hso-international/

**

• Own end-to-end service delivery across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data solutions.

• Build trusted relationships with senior customer stakeholders and align services with their business objectives.

• Lead and coach the DevOps customer support team.

• Own SLAs, service performance, budgets, escalations, and continuous improvement.

• Lead Release & Change Management, including release governance, CAB processes, risk assessment and production deployments.

• Coordinate releases and resolve dependencies across functional and technical teams.

• Identify opportunities to improve and expand customer services.

• Contribute to service delivery standards and best practices within Managed Services.

**

• A Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business, IT, or a related field.

• At least 10 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial experience within Microsoft Dynamics 365 and enterprise managed services.

• Senior-level Service Delivery Management experience in complex customer environments.

• Proven ownership of multiple services across Dynamics 365 F&O, CE, Azure, integrations, and data.

• Proven Release & Change Management experience, including release governance, CAB processes, and production deployment ownership.

• Experience managing SLAs, budgets, service quality, customer satisfaction, and escalations.

• Strong knowledge of Microsoft cloud solutions and modern service management practices.

• Experience working with international customers and distributed delivery teams.

• Commercial awareness and the ability to support service growth opportunities.

• Fluency in English.

**Strong Advantages

**

• Experience transitioning projects into managed service operations.

• Experience with Dynamics 365 One Version Management.

• ITIL certification or experience working for a Microsoft Partner.

**You Are

**

• Accountable and customer-focused.

• Able to oversee complex services involving multiple technologies and stakeholders.

• Calm and decisive when managing escalations and production risks.

• A strong communicator who can translate complex topics into clear decisions and actions.

• Collaborative, proactive, quality-minded and commercially aware.

**Why should you choose HSO International?

****Development and growth

**You get a job with plenty of career opportunities with a leading provider of innovative enterprise business solutions and distinct Microsoft Global Solution Integrator, who perceives your motivations, talents and ambitions.

**Fun and success

**You work in a collaborative and professional environment where success is built on teamwork and with colleagues who are ready to help each other.

**International project exposure

**Joining our team offers an exciting opportunity to engage in international projects, providing invaluable exposure to diverse cultures, markets, and perspectives. Through your involvement in these projects, you will broaden your global network, enhance your cross-cultural communication skills, and gain firsthand experience in navigating the complexities of international collaboration.

**Freedom and responsibility

**You have the freedom and flexibility to organize your workdays, but especially to shape your own career.

**Take the next step!

**Does the combination of business processes and Microsoft technology appeal to you? Take the next step in your career path with HSO International!

Are you passionate about app development with integration for hardware? Do you want to become part of an experienced development team of full stack software engineers and make your mark on Kamstrup’s Field Tools? Are you ready for an exciting and educational internship in an international green-tech company?

Here is what the job entails

During your internship, you will be working with your team as well as the Product Managers in our Project Team. Together, you will be developing our application for the Windows, Android and iOS platforms. This includes communication with our meters through a serial or wireless connection.

We are developing our apps in Microsoft Visual Studio - .NET/C# from where you will be working with one or more of the following technologies during your internship:

• .NET / C#

• Cross-platform development in .NET MAUI

• XAML

• SQL / SQLite

• MVVM design pattern

• Build pipelines in GitLab

• Bluetooth and wM-Bus communication

The specific contents of your tasks will be planned according to your wishes and your competencies and will depend on the features we will implement. Experience in the technologies we use is not a requirement; the most important thing is that you are eager to learn.

Meet your future team

As our Intern in .NET App Development, you will become a part of a software team in our Water business unit - Hardware department, consisting of five Software Developers with backgrounds such as Software Engineers and Physicists. The team develops meter configuration solutions and field tool applications for Windows, Android, and iOS. We are continuously working on improving and optimizing our field tools, so they become more user-friendly. By doing so, we ensure our position as a customer-preferred partner in the field.

Did you know? Only about half of our team drinks coffee — the rest run on pure code, energy drinks, or maybe just sheer willpower.

Less about us, more about you

We are looking for a motivated student who is ready to work with applications and whose commitment and theoretical knowledge can contribute to further development across platforms.

In order to succeed, we imagine that you:

• Are studying Software Technology (IKT), Computer Science, or similar. Most importantly, you are passionate about developing applications

• Have an analytical mindset and enjoy solving complex problems

• Are proactive in seeking knowledge and value professional sparring

• Can work independently while being a strong team player

• Bring a critical sense that enables you to establish the best decision-making

As we are an international organisation it is important that you fluent in English both orally and written. Danish will be considered an advantage.

Whilst you may not meet all the qualifications listed above, this is an internship position, and we value curiosity and a willingness to learn just as much as experience. If the role interests you and you are motivated to grow, we encourage you to apply.

We offer more than just an internship

At Kamstrup, your contribution as an intern is highly valued, and we cherish the good colleagueship. Therefore, you will experience an internship with a strong focus on your individual development through challenging tasks, career sparring, voluntary courses, as well as social events and a large network. We are proud, that our internship program has resulted in Studenterhus Aarhus granting us with the Mentor Award, the Internationalization Award, the Jury’s Special Award and the award for East Jutland’s Best Internship.

Besides the best program, we also offer:

• The internship is paid if your place of study allows it

• Multiple internship events and weekly internship lunches

• Employee benefits including a healthy canteen, fitness facilities, in-house dental clinic, hairdresser, and a free health clinic

• An active employee association, that fosters a collaborative and supportive workplace community

Do you want to be a part of Kamstrup?

Click on this link and apply now. The applications are reviewed on a continuous basis, but you can expect a response within six weeks. Any details about the internship will be individually agreed upon. However, the internship is expected to run from the beginning of February 2027 until the end of June 2027.

Kamstrup is located in Stilling south of Aarhus, and bus number 200 takes you right to the door.

If you have any questions about the position, please contact Manager, Product Tools & Apps, Jan Alexandersen on telephone nr.: +45 89 93 10 00.

Complex international HVAC projects demand more than strong project plans. They require disciplined commercial leadership, reliable cross-functional execution, and timely decisions across markets, contracts, and technical disciplines.

NOVENCO are looking for a Director of Project Execution to lead NOVENCO’s project portfolio across Denmark, Netherlands, UK, DACH, APAC and US. You will strengthen how we deliver safely, profitably, and consistently from order handover to final customer acceptance and satisfaction.

****Your Impact

• Lead the Project Execution function across NOVENCO, ensuring safe, timely, profitable, and contractually compliant delivery.

• Set the functional direction, operating model, governance standards, and long-term capability roadmap for Project Execution.

• Own portfolio performance across revenue, gross margin, cash flow, working capital, forecasting, risk, quality, and customer commitments.

• Lead and develop Project Managers and project execution teams through clear priorities, effective decision rights, succession planning, and coaching.

• Align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, Finance, installation, and commissioning around common delivery plans and commercial outcomes.

• Guide major customer escalations, contractual negotiations, claims, recovery actions, and commercial decisions within NOVENCO’s delegated authority framework.

****What Drives Success

• Extensive leadership experience from international HVAC, mechanical contracting, EPC, construction, or industrial project delivery.

• Proven accountability for a complex project portfolio, including margin, cash, risk, forecasting, contracts, and customer escalations.

• Strong financial and organizational judgement that turns business strategy into clear priorities, governance, and executable plans.

• The ability to lead experienced professionals and Project managers across functions, cultures, countries, and competing commercial priorities.

• A relevant degree or equivalent experience; PMP, IPMA, PRINCE2, or comparable certification is an advantage.

****Real Impact Example

****A major international project portfolio is facing changing customer requirements, capacity constraints, margin pressure, and several contractual interfaces. You enable your team to establish a fact-based portfolio review, clarify decision rights, strengthen change control, and align Sales, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, and project leadership around a shared recovery plan. Within short time the team improves forecast accuracy, and brings critical projects back within their approved delivery plans. Just as importantly, the new governance becomes a repeatable standard across all four countries.

****What We Offer

• A leadership role with responsibility for international project execution across NOVENCO’s established markets.

• The opportunity to shape NOVENCO’s Project Execution strategy, operating model, leadership capability, and delivery standards.

• Direct influence on the commercial and operational performance of complex, technically demanding HVAC projects.

• Close collaboration with senior leadership and experienced colleagues across commercial, technical, financial, and operational functions.

• Professional development and training through NOVENCollege.

• 25 days’ annual leave plus 5 days Feriefri after the qualifying period.

• Standard auto-enrolment pension scheme and access to a healthcare scheme.

• Competitive salary and employee benefits in line with company policy.

****Context

****You will lead a team of 8-10 people across NOVENCO and report directly to the CEO. The position combines strategic functional leadership with regular engagement in major projects and customer relationships.

**How To Apply

**Please submit your CV via our careers site. Applications will be reviewed on an ongoing basis, and interviews will be scheduled as suitable candidates are identified.

NOVENCO Building & Industry is an equal opportunity employer and welcomes applications from candidates of all backgrounds.

**Bring your engineering expertise to processes that help protect lives every day

**Do you enjoy solving complex manufacturing challenges and turning technical insight into lasting improvements?

At Bavarian Nordic, we are looking for a Engineering Specialist to strengthen our Drug Substance manufacturing processes and support the introduction of new equipment and technologies.

You will join Material & Sterile Operation, reporting to the Senior Manager, and combine hands-on problem-solving with technical leadership. Your work will help ensure that our processes deliver reliable performance, consistent quality, and GMP compliance.

**Your impact

**As a technical expert for your assigned process areas, you will help develop, optimize, validate, and maintain manufacturing processes throughout their lifecycle. You will challenge existing solutions, identify risks before they affect production, and turn improvement opportunities into practical results.

Working across Manufacturing, Engineering, Automation, and Quality, you will also share your expertise and strengthen process understanding across teams.

**What You Will Do

**

• Improve process performance: Lead process design and optimization, address bottlenecks and operational risks, and troubleshoot complex manufacturing challenges to improve efficiency, reliability, and quality.

• Provide expertise in CIP/SIP: Act as a Subject Matter Expert for Cleaning-in-Place and Sterilization-in-Place systems, improving system design, component selection, and cleaning and sterilization strategies.

• Introduce equipment and technologies: Guide technical activities from specifications and vendor design reviews through factory and site acceptance testing, commissioning, qualification, and validation.

• Support validation and technology transfer: Develop validation strategies, lead and support Process Performance Qualification (PPQ), and drive the transfer of processes into manufacturing or between sites.

• Strengthen compliance: Lead and support deviations, root cause investigations, CAPAs, change controls, and risk assessments. Represent your technical areas during audits and inspections.

• Develop technical capability: Coach colleagues, provide training, and share engineering knowledge to strengthen process understanding and consistent execution.

**What You Bring

**You hold a master’s degree in Chemical, Bioprocess, Process, or Mechanical Engineering, or a related engineering discipline, and have at least 10 years of industrial process engineering experience.

You bring:

• A strong track record in process design, optimization, and structured troubleshooting within GMP manufacturing. Experience in pharmaceuticals, biotechnology, vaccines, or another highly regulated industry is strongly preferred.

• Extensive hands-on expertise in CIP/SIP design, operation, and optimization.

• In-depth knowledge of process equipment, piping, valves, and instrumentation, together with an understanding of how process and automation systems interact.

• Experience with equipment introduction, qualification, validation, PPQ, and technology transfer, including changes requiring regulatory approval.

• Solid knowledge of pharmaceutical quality systems and regulatory expectations, with practical experience in investigations, CAPAs, change controls, risk assessments, and inspection support.

**How You Work

**You combine analytical thinking with practical judgement and take ownership of moving issues towards resolution.

You are comfortable questioning established practices and can explain why a proposed change will improve process performance or reduce risk.

You communicate complex technical topics clearly, build constructive relationships across functions, and balance attention to detail with an understanding of production needs and business priorities. You also enjoy helping others develop through coaching, knowledge sharing, and collaboration.

**An opportunity to grow your leadership

**This role offers the opportunity to make an immediate impact through technical leadership. For the right candidate, it may also provide a pathway into formal people management, potentially leading a team of approximately 8–10 Process Engineers.

Progression will depend on demonstrated performance, sound judgement, and the ability to develop others, build an inclusive team environment, and translate business priorities into practical execution.

**Why join Bavarian Nordic?

**At Bavarian Nordic, we work to protect lives through vaccines. Your engineering expertise will contribute directly to the manufacturing processes that make this possible.

You will have opportunities to influence technical solutions, support important technology transfers, and see your improvements become part of daily operations. Guided by our values—Persisting Pioneers, Embracing Change, and Boosted by the Team—we work together to solve challenges and strengthen our capabilities

About MITS Industries

MITS Industries is establishing an R&D and design site in Copenhagen focused on advanced RF systems, signal intelligence, aerospace technologies, and mission-critical product development.

The site will build core engineering capabilities in RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, RF testing and characterization, rugged mechanical integration, and the industrialization of complex radio-electronic systems.

The Copenhagen team will work closely with strategic partners and engineering teams across Europe, playing a leading role in the development, validation, and industrialization of advanced technologies for defense, aerospace, and other demanding applications.

One of the initial focus areas will be the development of an advanced aerospace signal intelligence product platform. The work will cover RF and system architecture, antenna system design, signal acquisition, embedded control, laboratory validation, mechanical integration, integration with the satellite platform, and preparation for production and field deployment.

The ambition is to build a strong technical design site capable of taking complex RF products, modules, and platforms from architecture and detailed design through prototyping, testing, validation, industrialization, and deployment.

About the role

MITS Industries is looking for a Senior Systems Engineer, RF Systems to join the core Copenhagen R&D team and help build the site’s systems engineering capability for advanced RF, aerospace, and signal-intelligence products. You will translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, and parametric requirements, system architectures, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, integration strategies, and verification plans. The work covers requirements decomposition and traceability, system performance budgeting, interface management, technical risk analysis, design reviews, integration planning, and system level verification and validation. You will work closely with RF and microwave hardware engineers, antenna systems engineers, embedded and control engineers, signal-processing engineers, RF test and characterization engineers, mechanical design engineers, project managers, and partner engineering teams. You will ensure that requirements, design decisions, implementation, integration, testing, and validation remain connected throughout the development lifecycle. The role requires strong RF system understanding, structured systems-engineering expertise, technical ownership, and a hands-on integration mindset. Working with technical leadership, you will turn product and architectural intent into an executable, traceable, and verifiable engineering baseline and help carry the product through integration, qualification, and deployment.

Key responsibilities

• Translate product, mission, and stakeholder needs into clear functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Develop and maintain the functional and physical system architecture, allocate requirements to subsystems, and define key technical trade-offs.

• Establish and maintain system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Define and maintain system requirements, subsystem requirements, interface control documentation, acceptance criteria, and verification logic.

• Align RF subsystem requirements, including frequency coverage, sensitivity, selectivity, dynamic range, noise figure, linearity, phase noise, spurious responses, channel isolation, and interference resilience.

• Define antenna-system requirements covering frequency coverage, antenna gain, polarization, radiation-pattern characteristics, isolation between antenna channels, placement, and platform integration.

• Define embedded control, data acquisition, timing, synchronization, diagnostics, logging, networking, and system-monitoring requirements.

• Coordinate mechanical and platform requirements covering dimensions, mass, thermal management, connectors, cabling, grounding, shielding, mounting, environmental constraints, and serviceability.

• Work with RF test and characterization engineers to define measurable acceptance criteria, calibration needs, verification methods, test coverage, and required evidence.

• Prepare and maintain system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, system budgets, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Lead system integration planning and support prototype bring-up, laboratory validation, qualification, and field-test preparation.

• Identify system-level risks, interface conflicts, missing requirements, invalid assumptions, and integration blockers, and drive their resolution.

• Facilitate cross-functional technical alignment between engineering disciplines, technical leadership, manufacturing partners, and partner engineering teams.

• Support requirements reviews, system design reviews, integration reviews, test readiness reviews, and milestone decisions.

• Maintain traceability between stakeholder needs, requirements, design decisions, implementation, verification results, and acceptance evidence.

• Help establish systems-engineering methods, documentation practices, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future MITS Industries development programs.

Required qualifications and experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in electrical or electronic engineering, telecommunications, systems engineering, aerospace engineering, applied physics, or a related field.

• 6+ years of professional experience in systems engineering for complex RF, electronic, aerospace, or other mission-critical systems.

• Strong understanding of RF systems, including receiver architectures, RF signal paths, antenna interfaces, signal acquisition, data conversion, embedded control, timing and synchronization, calibration, and system validation.

• Proven experience translating product, mission, and stakeholder needs into functional, performance, parametric, interface, environmental, and verification requirements.

• Experience developing functional and physical system architectures, decomposing systems into subsystems, allocating requirements, and defining interfaces and technical trade-offs.

• Experience establishing and maintaining system performance budgets and constraints covering RF performance, timing and synchronization, data flow, power, thermal performance, mass, and platform interfaces.

• Strong understanding of requirements decomposition, traceability, acceptance criteria, and verification methods, including analysis, inspection, demonstration, and testing.

• Experience preparing and maintaining system requirements specifications, interface-control documents, integration plans, verification plans, compliance matrices, and technical decision records.

• Practical experience with requirements-management and traceability tools such as IBM Engineering DOORS, Jama Connect, Polarion, or equivalent.

• Experience working with cross-functional engineering teams covering RF and microwave hardware, antennas, embedded systems, signal processing, mechanical design, test, manufacturing, and system integration.

• Ability to evaluate technical trade-offs across RF performance, embedded implementation, mechanical and thermal constraints, testability, manufacturability, reliability, and operational use.

• Hands-on experience with prototype integration, laboratory validation, system-level debugging, and troubleshooting of complex multidisciplinary systems.

• Experience identifying and managing system-level risks, interface conflicts, assumptions, technical dependencies, and integration blockers. Strong technical communication and facilitation skills, with the ability to align senior engineers and drive decisions across engineering disciplines.

Nice to have

• Experience with signal-intelligence, direction-finding, spectrum-monitoring, or radio-surveillance systems.

• Experience with SDR-based systems and high-throughput RF data acquisition.

• Experience with broadband, multiband, coherent, or multichannel receiver systems.

• Experience with Model-Based Systems Engineering, SysML, and tools such as Cameo Systems Modeler, Enterprise Architect, or equivalent.

• Experience establishing and maintaining controlled system baselines, including requirements, interfaces, verification status, configuration, and engineering changes.

• Experience with engineering analysis, data processing, or system modelling using MATLAB, Python, or equivalent.

• Experience with field integration, testing, calibration, and deployment of complex RF or aerospace systems.

• Experience working on aerospace, mission-critical, ruggedized, or internationally distributed engineering programs.

Success in the first 6 months

• Establish the initial system requirements baseline, subsystem allocation, interface definitions, and performance budgets for the assigned product scope.

• Create a clear technical decomposition across RF and microwave hardware, antenna systems, embedded control, signal processing, mechanical design, test, and system integration.

• Define the integration, verification, and validation approach for the initial prototype or subsystem, including acceptance criteria, traceability, and required evidence.

• Identify unclear interfaces, missing requirements, technical assumptions, and system-level risks early, and drive practical resolution actions. Support prototype integration, bring-up, and laboratory validation with structured system-level analysis, troubleshooting, and verification evidence.

• Establish repeatable systems-engineering practices, documentation templates, requirements-management workflows, and technical-review processes for future development programs.

Are you motivated by how companies decide which products, technologies, and business opportunities to invest in? Do you enjoy combining market insight, customer needs, financial potential, and strategic analysis to support difficult decisions? Are you looking for an internship where you can contribute to strategic portfolio decisions in Kamstrup’s international Heat/Cooling business?

Here is what your role entails

As our intern, you will work closely with Strategic Portfolio Management on questions that influence the direction of the Heat/Cooling business. You will contribute to portfolio strategy, evaluate business opportunities, analyse the balance of the portfolio, and help prepare recommendations for prioritisation and investment decisions.

More specifically, you will be:

• Contributing to the annual portfolio strategy process for the Heat/Cooling business

• Mapping customer needs, market trends, competitor movements, and technology developments

• Analysing business opportunities and assessing their strategic fit and value potential

• Developing business cases, portfolio dashboards, and decision material for management reviews

• Supporting prioritisation discussions across development initiatives

You will take ownership of analytical assignments and contribute directly to ongoing portfolio decisions. At the same time, you will gain insight into how strategic choices are made across Product Management, Sales, Finance, and Research and Development.

Meet your future team

You will become part of our Product Management Team in the Heat/Cooling department, where you will work closely together with Strategic Portfolio Management. In Strategic Portfolio Management, we challenge ideas, prioritize business opportunities, and then support them as projects on their way to our customers. Using sales numbers, market input, customer interviews, and strategic priorities, we give guidance to the organization on what to build next. FirePoint Rocket Technology is building one of the most unique and strategically important industrial projects in Denmark - a new production facility for solid rocket propellant and advanced defense-tech components. It is a Danish-based defense technology company, part of the international Fire Point Group — a fast-growing ecosystem born out of Ukraine’s innovation and resilience. Joining FPRT now means becoming part of the core team shaping a new high-tech, safety-critical production environment from the ground up.

They are looking for a Maintenance & Engineering Manager who will establish and execute an absolute, zero-compromise reliability strategy from day one.

The Role

As the Maintenance & Engineering Manager, you are responsible for the operational integrity, availability, and safety of all production assets and process equipment. Manufacturing rocket propellant leaves no room for trial and error—our process equipment must be predictable, fully mastered down to the individual component, and maintained at peak condition.

Reporting directly to the Chief Production Officer (CPO), you will lead the technical team in deep equipment mastery, anticipating service intervals with precision, and proactively replacing high-risk components before failures occur. You will work in close functional alignment with Process Engineering, Manufacturing Automation, EHS, Quality, and Production Planning to ensure seamless, compliant operations.

What You Will Do

1. Production Maintenance Strategy & Asset Management

• Develop and implement a preventive and predictive maintenance strategy for all production equipment, focusing on long-cycle and batch-based processes (mixers, thermal curing ovens, polymerization, climate-controlled chambers) to ensure thermal stability and high uptime.

• Minimize downtime by transitioning from reactive repairs to condition-based monitoring and planned interventions.

• Lead the selection, implementation, and management of a CMMS (Computerized Maintenance Management System) to track work orders, asset history, and maintenance costs.

• Integrate maintenance requirements into the equipment acquisition process alongside QA, establishing preventive risk assessments and managing obsolescence planning.

2. Process Utilities & Production Support Engineering

• Oversee point-of-use process utilities directly feeding production lines, such as process vacuum, specialized process gas loops, and line-dedicated thermal fluids.

• Coordinate with internal and external facility teams on utility drop interfaces to ensure production machinery interface readiness.

3. EHS & Process Safety Compliance

• Enforce strict adherence to EHS standards across all equipment maintenance activities.

• Rigorously execute Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and "Permit to Work" systems on energetic material processing machinery and hazardous equipment zones.

4. Production Spare Parts & Technical Inventory

• Define critical spare parts strategies for production machinery to balance inventory costs with operational risk mitigation.

• Partner with the Warehouse team to track, store, and preserve technical production spares correctly.

• Monitor market lifecycle status for key equipment components and execute end-of-life obsolescence planning.

5. Team Leadership & Technical Development

• Lead, mentor, and schedule a team of production maintenance technicians and equipment specialists.

• Ensure the team is fully trained in safety protocols (ATEX, energetic materials) and advanced technical troubleshooting.

• Plan technician resources and build mechanical redundancy strategies to protect production during interventions or unplanned events.

6. Production Line CapEx & Commissioning Support

• Support the installation, mechanical integration, and commissioning of new production lines with Process Engineering and Automation.

• Provide early input on machine "serviceability and accessibility" during the design phase to eliminate future shop-floor bottlenecks.

First 90 Days – Expected Outcomes

• Critical spare parts inventory analysis completed and gaps identified.

• Preventative Maintenance (PM) schedule established for all key production assets.

• Maintenance team skills matrix assessed and training plan initiated.

• Design of the “obtain equipment” process and equipment lifecycle framework completed in collaboration with QA.

What We Offer

• A rare career opportunity to lead the engineering and maintenance function for one of Denmark's most unique industrial and defense-tech projects.

• A role where your technical expertise directly determines the reliability and safety of high-stakes, safety-critical production.

• A professional, international environment with a clear mission and purpose.

• Technical Mastery: Strong working knowledge of mechanical systems (hydraulics, pneumatics, rotating equipment), electrical systems, and industrial automation (PLC, SCADA).

Are you the kind of person who notices what others overlook? Do you need to understand the whole picture before you trust a solution? And do you get energy from learning new things while keeping an eye on the details?

Then read on!

For Relewise, we are looking for a sharp, hands-on engineer to help evolve Relewise's core platform. We are looking for someone with sound engineering judgment, system-wide understanding, and the ability to assess complex designs and implementations, including AI-generated work.

Location: Aarhus (or hybrid)

You have a "no-bullshit" filter that errors rarely slip through. You notice what others overlook, and you dare to challenge when your critical sense catches something that doesn't make sense.

• 
You need to see the common thread before you act. You spot when things don't add up, and you want to understand the full context so you're not guessing.

• 
You value structure and deliver high-quality work. You are thorough, see your tasks through to the end, and make sure details are not forgotten on your watch.

• 
You're quick to learn new things and get to grips with new areas. At the same time, you dig to the bottom of things because you value thoroughness and precision.

• 
You always have a good overview, and you find it easy to work on even complex projects. You know where things stand, and you prioritise ruthlessly how your time is best spent.

• 
You get energy from solving problems, because challenges are fun and exciting to you. You're not afraid to take something apart to see what it is and what it can do, and you often think "what if".

Your responsibilities will be:

Design and deliver features across the core search and recommendation engine, directing groups of coding agents as your own development team.

• 
Review code, both human-written and AI-generated, and, once sufficiently familiar with the platform, join the small group of "Last Defense" reviewers who determine whether changes are ready for production.

• 
Improve performance, scalability and resilience using profiling and production evidence.

• 
Own your changes through deployment and maintenance. When incidents occur, you investigate them systematically to find the root cause, ensuring we learn from the history and prevent similar issues in the future.

You have deep practical production experience with C# and .NET.

Search, recommendation systems and/or e-commerce.

Domain-Driven Design. Clear modelling and sound reasoning matter more than terminology.

You'll have daily technical partnership with our Lead Engineer and CTO, and every Friday we meet to discuss progress and lessons learned. A role where you help set the standard for quality in a platform that reaches consumers across Europe.

• 
The opportunity to develop your skills in AI-first development alongside a highly skilled team.

• 
A work environment where we strive to understand you, so we can set you up for success in terms of tasks, leadership style and team culture.

jobs.description:
The Proteomics Research Infrastructure (PRI) is a cutting-edge core facility specializing in mass spectrometry (MS)-based proteomics. PRI provides researchers with end-to-end support, including project consultation, automated sample preparation, mass spectrometry acquisition, and advanced data analysis. Established within the Novo Nordisk Foundation Center for Protein Research (CPR) and now part of the Center for Core Facilities (CCF), PRI operates in an international, collaborative, and innovation-driven environment. English is the primary working language.

  We are seeking an experienced Proteomics Application Specialist (Special Consultant) to support and further develop PRI's clinical proteomics and single-cell proteomics pipelines.

  
 Job description
 The Proteomics Application Specialist will be an integral member of the PRI team and will play a key role in the development and operation of advanced proteomics applications and service pipelines, with particular emphasis on clinical proteomics and emerging single-cell workflows. The position involves planning, performing, analyzing, and documenting advanced proteomic experiments, as well as contributing to the development, optimization, and implementation of robust, reproducible, and scalable laboratory workflows. The successful candidate will work closely with the PRI team, particularly the Proteomics Service Manager, and will report directly to the PRI Director.

  Key responsibilities

   	
• Plan, execute, analyze, and document experiments within PRI's proteomics service pipelines. 	
• Support and further develop clinical proteomics and single-cell proteomics workflows. 	
• Perform sample preparation for proteomics analyses, including the processing of large-scale cohorts comprising thousands of samples. 	
• Operate, maintain, troubleshoot, and optimize automated sample preparation and liquid-handling platforms. 	
• Operate and support state-of-the-art LC-MS instrumentation and related proteomics technologies. 	
• Perform proteomics data analysis using specialized software and contribute to high-quality interpretation of experimental results. 	
• Maintain comprehensive and accurate experimental documentation using electronic laboratory notebooks and project and sample management systems. 	
• Contribute to the development, validation, standardization, and continuous improvement of laboratory workflows. 	
• Support the implementation of scalable and reproducible processes to ensure high quality and efficiency across PRI's service activities. 	
• Collaborate with researchers, project partners, and PRI colleagues in an international and multidisciplinary environment. 	
• Contribute to the development of new applications and technologies relevant to PRI's research and service portfolio. 	
• Perform other relevant duties as required to support the activities and strategic development of PRI.   Qualifications
 We are looking for a reliable, well-organized, and highly motivated scientist who is able to work independently while contributing effectively to a collaborative team environment. The position requires flexibility, accuracy, attention to detail, and a strong commitment to high-quality laboratory work and service delivery.

  The ideal candidate will have:

   	
• A PhD degree in molecular biology, biochemistry, proteomics, or a related field. 	
• Demonstrated expertise in molecular biology, biochemistry, proteomics, or related laboratory techniques. 	
• Demonstrated experience with state-of-the-art LC-MS-based proteomics, including experience with Bruker timsTOF and Thermo Fisher Astral platforms. 	
• Experience with proteomics sample preparation and the handling of large-scale sample cohorts. 	
• Experience with automated liquid-handling platforms and laboratory automation. 	
• Experience with data analysis and specialized software relevant to mass spectrometry-based proteomics. 	
• Strong computer literacy, including experience with databases and laboratory/project management systems. 	
• Excellent organizational skills and the ability to independently plan and execute complex experimental workflows. 	
• Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.   The following qualifications will be considered advantageous:

   	
• Previous experience in clinical proteomics. 	
• Previous experience in single-cell proteomics. 	
• Experience with automated sample preparation workflows and sample management systems. 	
• Experience working in a proteomics core facility or other service-oriented research environment. 	
• Experience with development, optimization, and implementation of standardized and scalable proteomics workflows.   Salary and Terms of Employment 
 The employment is a fixed-term position until 30 June 2030. The estimated start date is 1 February 2027. Working hours are 37 hours per week.

  Employment will be as Special Consultant (Staff Scientist) under The Circular on the Collective Agreement concerning Academics in the state sector concluded between the Danish Ministry of Finance and Akademikerne (the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations). There will be an opportunity to negotiate supplements based on qualifications. You can read more about salary levels in the state sector www.loenoverblik.dk (in Danish). 

  Application 
 If you are interested in the position, please submit your electronic application, including attachments, via the UCPH Job Portal (click the “APPLY NOW” link at the bottom of the job posting). 

  Your application must include:

 Informal enquiries about the position can be addressed to the PRI director Michael Wierer; michael.wierer@pri.ku.dk. For more information on PRI visit: www.pri.ku.dk
